collection.title: BMW 3 Series Touring 1999 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 1999 to 2005 version of a BMW 3 Series Touring requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this 3 Series Touring which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
